wonder.name: tiktok_post_newest_gallery_video
wonder.intent: Post the newest gallery video to TikTok with a chosen sound and caption
wonder.description: Opens TikTok, creates a post from the newest video in the phone gallery, searches TikTok's sound library for the requested sound and applies it, then adds the requested caption and dismisses the keyboard for review.

inputs.name: sound_title
inputs.description: Title of the sound to find in TikTok's sound library.

inputs.name: sound_artist
inputs.description: Artist of the sound to find in TikTok's sound library.

inputs.name: caption
inputs.description: Caption to enter as the post description.
inputs.example: Envoy rehearsal: one clip, three apps

steps.intent: Tap Create to start a new post
Tap Upload to open the gallery
Tap the first, newest video in the gallery list
Tap Next to proceed to the editor with the selected video
Tap the Music area to open the sound library
Tap Search in the Add sound sheet
Tap Search to execute the search for {{sound_title}} by {{sound_artist}}
Tap the apply/check control for the first result matching {{sound_title}} by {{sound_artist}}
Tap the {{sound_title}} by {{sound_artist}} sound result to select it
Tap the video preview to close the sound sheet and return to editing
Tap Next to proceed to the caption and post screen
Type {{caption}} into the Add description field
Press back to close the keyboard and review the preview before posting
